method: The decisions rest on takedown-variants-v1254k (candidate 1214cs, harness 1254h) under the product controller with natural guard AI and the NPC stream on, both source roles: the case waits until Dunwall tutorial guard 2 stands still at his long patrol pause, holds the free camera 3.6 m ahead of him looking back, places the source 3 m above and slightly behind him, and presses the attack (lethal) or choke (nonlethal) while falling. The source must play a native drop takedown, the partner must present every census scene it played, both worlds must reach the same outcome (dead or unconscious) and the victim must end within 2 m in both worlds; the checkpoint is reloaded after every case. Earlier functional evidence: audit 1257 (drop scenes 19 and 58 presented and shared) and takedown-variants-v1254g (passing, poorly framed).

items.scope: The drop assassination (assassination_drop_back, 1800-2000 ms) in both source roles: presented on the partner from the native scene, the guard dead in both worlds at the same place.

visual.verdict: Corvo falls from above onto the guard, drives him down and rises with the sword raised over the body.
Emily lands behind the guard from above and he crumples forward onto the floor; she straightens over the body.

items.scope: The drop choke (choke_drop_ready then choke_drop_back, 2166-2633 ms) in both source roles: presented on the partner, the guard unconscious in both worlds at the same place.

visual.verdict: Corvo drops onto the guard, forces him to his knees and holds him in the choke until he slumps to the floor.
Emily lands on the guard from above and takes him down; he lies unconscious at her feet.
